overall_summary: The sample size is very small, with overall views hovering in the low double digits across all uploads. However, subtle engagement signals suggest that themes merging digital artifacts (chats, typing indicators, saved numbers) with personal boundaries or self-respect perform slightly better than pure passive sadness.

winning_patterns.evidence: AfaLxMy6FMY ('चैट डिलीट करने की हिम्मत...') achieved the highest views (33) among all videos by focusing on a concrete, empowering action rather than just lingering sadness.
winning_patterns.action: Blend modern smartphone behavior (deleting chats, blocking, leaving groups) with emotional self-worth.

weak_patterns.evidence: Videos like uIbMpCjVutQ ('मेज पर रखी चाय ठंडी हो गई') garnered minimal traction (5 views), indicating that abstract or poetic imagery without an immediate modern hook underperforms.
weak_patterns.action: Avoid abstract poetic metaphors in the opening hook; stick to concrete, instantly recognizable everyday situations.
